title: Target Pointing: Baseline model, bugs
resolution: First target engage now slews to active_target_index 0 (first/closest along sequence), not a far-ahead target on the ground track. Baseline rollout uses policy.active_anchor() via stepper.set_obc_ground_target_xy_km on engage.

typed_captions: First target pointing: moves to ~10th target not to the first / closest
handwriting: No clouds in green areas, suspicious
figure_annotations: Top screenshot (nadir approach): two green hand-drawn circles on the blue sensor footprint over Earth's surface — annotator flags missing clouds in those green-marked regions.

Middle screenshot (target pointing, frame ~672): green arrow/line from current satellite position toward a red target dot farther along the ground track (~10th target), not the nearest/first target dot. Handwritten 'Expected this' beside the indicated target.

Dashboard context: SATELLITE OVERFLIGHT — ORBIT & IMAGING DASHBOARD; control mode sequential_target_baseline; altitude ~548 km; attitude z off-nadir ~-42.6°; active target 0; capture reward latent 10.92 applied 0.00.

summary: Baseline target-pointing bug report (2026-06-24). Nadir approach looks correct. On first target-pointing engagement the satellite slewed toward approximately the 10th target along the track instead of the first/closest target. FIXED: engage now points at the active sequential target (index 0 first). Open: green-circled nadir footprint areas still flagged as suspicious for missing clouds.
